ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Meeting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Exploring and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.

2. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.

3. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

4. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

5. A — newton (N)

6. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.

7. D — Ice melting to water

8. D — Producers

9. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

10. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.

11. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.

12. A — 100 °C

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Enterprise projects environment; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Exploring; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
